fullPassage: Dear Monica, It was good to see you at the funeral service for my mother last week; it was comforting to be surrounded by family and friends. At the end of the day you told me that my mother had promised you her pearl ring. It was not the appropriate time for me to discuss your request, but I did want to let you know my thoughts now. That lovely ring is of special meaning in my family. My father bought it when he was stationed in the Pacific in World War II. My mother proudly wore it for more than forty years. After my daughter Tina was born, we used to say that someday when she married someone it would be hers. My mother never said otherwise, and there is no mention of giving it to you in her will. I am sure you will understand that we want this remembrance of my mother to remain in the family. Sincerely, Chris Walker

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① comforted: 비인칭 주어 it + 감정유발 형용사 자리. 'it was comforting to be...' = '...이 위로가 되었다'. comforted는 '(사람이) 위로받은' 의미로 사람 주어에 맞음 → 비인칭 주어 it과 불일치.
✅ ② stationed: 'he was stationed in the Pacific' = 수동태(be + p.p.) → 군이 그를 배치한 것이므로 수동 정상.
✅ ③ otherwise: 'never said otherwise' = '달리 말한 적 없다' → 부사 역할 정상.
✅ ④ remain: 'want this remembrance to remain' = to부정사 + 동사원형 정상.
det.tip: 감정유발동사의 현재분사(-ing) vs 과거분사(-ed): 사물/상황이 주어 → -ing(comforting). 사람이 주어 → -ed(comforted). 비인칭 it + comforting이 맞음.

✅ ③ proudly: 어머니가 '자랑스럽게(proudly)' 40년 착용 → 적절.
❌ ④ always: '항상 달리 말했다'가 되면, Tina에게 반지를 줄 것이라는 가족의 믿음과 모순. always → never로 교체해야 문맥 성립.
det.tip: never said otherwise = '반대 의사를 표명한 적 없다' → 어머니도 Tina에게 줄 것에 동의했음. always로 바꾸면 의미 역행.
